known_limitations: Bailey's printed page carries a narrow marginal synopsis column (short topic labels) beside the main translation; the flat OCR interleaves fragments of that column into the same line as the main prose, mid-sentence, with no reliable per-line signal to separate them. This script does not attempt to strip them: a sparse residue of marginal-gloss word fragments may appear inline in the extracted text. Not fixed by patches (too diffuse to enumerate); disclosed here rather than silently left unclean.
